bands.deed: Keep the engine plane current through its owning source, build, health, and promotion tools.
Apply scoped profile migrations through the additive hotfix declaration and per-body ledger.
Materialize the profile and refresh its projection at the update prelude.
Execute routine source children through their owning tools; rolling-update source acquisition occurs in the prelude.
Compare the projected profile and modules before execution.
Execute the owning package, binary, service, file, and proposal tools in module order.
Execute binary builds and promotion through the owning build-crate and place-file tools.
Execute managed-file work through the owning file and symlink tools.
Execute service transitions through the owning service and health tools.
Use the owning file tools and proposal projection for proposal work.
Report the run receipt, stdout, and result.

rolling_update: pull-source routine band (rolling-update source acquisition occurs in a prelude outside the band walk)
compare profile shape and module-group selection
